docs.title: Vault18 Card Catalog
docs.text: Welcome to the Vault18 Card Catalog! This is a comprehensive guide to managing and tracking your trading card collections.

docs.title: Collections
docs.text:
Explore detailed information about each of your trading card games:

  • Magic: The Gathering - The collectible card game of wizards and spells
  • Pokémon - Gotta catch 'em all!
  • Yu-Gi-Oh! - Duel monsters and strategic gameplay
  • Lorcana - The Disney Lorcana trading card game
  • One Piece - Adventure on the high seas

docs.title: Storage
docs.text: • Bulk Storage - Information about bulk storage and organization

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text:
Each collection section contains: - Inventory tracking - Set information - Storage locations - Condition guides - Valuation notes

Start by exploring a collection section to begin cataloging your cards!

docs.title: Bulk Storage
docs.text: This section documents your bulk card storage and organization system.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Bulk storage is used for: - Common and uncommon cards - Bulk lots - Cards awaiting organization - Overflow from main collections

docs.title: Storage Locations
docs.text: Document where your bulk cards are stored: - Container type (box, bin, etc.) - Location - Contents summary - Last updated date

docs.title: Organization Tips
docs.text:
• Group by card game
  • Organize by color/type when applicable
  • Keep inventory notes
  • Regular maintenance and rotation

docs.title: Inventory
docs.text: Track your bulk inventory including: - Container ID/name - Game type - Approximate card count - Notable cards (if any) - Storage location
